body:
Dylan Brooks: Post-beta cleanup sweep for guided onboarding checklist before we flip GA defaults. I’m collecting the “must do” items so we don’t ship beta baggage.

Top items I have:
- remove debug logs + debug-only headers from Console + backend
- tighten permission checks on admin/reset + state APIs (org/project boundaries)
- finalize GA defaults (flag targeting, step validation lag messaging, telemetry sampling)

If you’ve seen anything sketchy during beta, reply here w/ details + owner.

Hannah Rivera: +1 on debug logs. I still see `console.debug("checklistState", ...)` in the component + a temporary `?onboardingDebug=1` query param that flips extra UI. I can remove both today.

Chloe Martin: Backend side: we left a temporary log line at INFO that prints payload sizes + dedupe keys for onboarding events. Not PII but it’s noisy and shows internal IDs we probably don’t want at INFO.

Proposing:
- drop to DEBUG
- add allowlist for log fields (no raw request/headers)

Jada Williams: Permissions: admin override endpoint is currently behind `internal_admin` role, but we’re not verifying project membership for the projectId passed in (it relies on downstream checks that aren’t consistent).

We should enforce:
- requester has admin role
- requester belongs to org
- projectId belongs to org
- record audit log entry (who/what/why)

I can take this + add unit tests.

Ethan Park: +1. Also noticed checklist state API accepts `org_id` in body even though we already have org from auth context. That’s a footgun. We should ignore body org_id entirely (or reject if it doesn’t match) and only use auth context.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: API key flow cleanup: the “prod vs test” label is shipping, but we left a hidden UI toggle that forces prod-mode in local env (`localStorage.forceProdKey=true`). Shouldn’t go to GA. I’ll remove + update e2e expectations.

Amara Diallo: Gateway/validation: during beta we enabled extra headers to help support debug first-success:
- `x-rw-project-id`
- `x-rw-request-source=console-onboarding`

We should keep `x-rw-request-source` (useful for attribution) but `x-rw-project-id` should not be injected by Console; it should be server-side derived. I can open a quick PR to remove it from client emission and ensure server attaches only internally.

Nadia Rahman: Telemetry: we still have sampling turned off (100%) for onboarding events in 2 regions from the beta config. For GA we agreed:
- keep 100% for step completion events
- sample “view/hover” type UI events (like checklist opened) at 10%

Also: retention tag isn’t set on `onboarding.step_validated` in one codepath (backend validator). That means it’ll fall back to default retention. I’ll patch.

Logan Wright: +1 on retention tags. Also want to add a guardrail in the ingestion pipeline for “unexpected properties” — right now we drop them, but we don’t alert. For GA I want an alert when property drop rate > 1% for onboarding events. That’s saved us before.

I can wire this into the existing telemetry health dashboard.

Leila Farouk: E2E tests: currently tests use the admin reset endpoint without auth hardening (we stub it in Cypress). Once Jada tightens permissions, we’ll need to update the test harness to request a real internal admin token in CI.

Also a bunch of tests assert on copy that changed during beta. I can sync them once we lock GA copy.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled: console-web @ 2025-02-13 22:00 UTC (release train). Feature flags unchanged.

Dylan Brooks: This is great. Summarizing owners + what “done” means:

1) Console debug cleanup (remove debug query param + console.debug) — Hannah
2) Backend log level + field allowlist — Chloe
3) Admin override + state API authZ hardening + audit log — Jada (w/ Ethan review)
4) Ignore/reject body org_id, use auth context — Ethan
5) Remove prod-key localStorage forcing toggle — Kaitlyn
6) Remove client injection of x-rw-project-id; keep request-source attribution — Amara
7) Telemetry sampling/retention fix — Nadia
8) Telemetry alert for property drop rate — Logan
9) Update E2E harness for new authZ + copy sync — Leila

Anything missing?

Chloe Martin: One more: we left a temporary DB index for beta experimentation on `checklist_state.updated_at`. It’s fine, but we should confirm it’s still needed (it was added to speed a backfill job that we’re not doing anymore). If we don’t need it, we should drop to reduce write overhead.

Ethan Park: I’ll check query plans and tell you whether it’s still used. My guess: can remove.

Hannah Rivera: FYI also saw a `window.__RW_ONBOARDING_FORCE_VALIDATE=true` gate in validator UI for local testing. I’ll remove along with the other debug toggles.

Nadia Rahman: Re: GA defaults: do we have final decision on flag targeting?
Last I saw: new orgs 100%, existing orgs 0% unless allowlisted.

Dylan Brooks: Yup, that’s still the plan for GA week 1.
- New orgs: ON by default
- Existing orgs: OFF by default, allowlist by Support/CS for now
- Admin override stays internal only

We’ll revisit % rollout to existing orgs after we see early GA funnel + telemetry health for ~1 week.

Amara Diallo: On gateway side I can also add a rule to strip any client-sent `x-rw-project-id` at the edge (defense in depth) and rely on our normal auth mapping. Will do.

Jada Williams: For audit log: do we have a standard event name? I’ll follow the internal audit stream naming:
`audit.onboarding_checklist.reset`
Props: actor_user_id, org_id, project_id, reason (required), source (console/admin)

Dylan Brooks: Works. Make “reason” required in the API, even if it’s just “support_request INT-####”.

Leila Farouk: Once that’s in, I’ll update Cypress helper to pass reason + verify it shows in audit logs in the test env (if accessible). If audit logs aren’t exposed, I’ll at least validate 200 + state reset.

Logan Wright: If you want to validate audit events exist, we can query in staging via Looker. I’ll DM a link to the dataset.

Chloe Martin: Timing: I can land backend log changes + (maybe) index removal by end of day tomorrow if Ethan confirms.

Ethan Park: I’ll confirm index usage today.

Dylan Brooks: Cool. Let’s aim to have all of these merged before the next release train so GA defaults flip isn’t blocked.

Please drop PR links in-thread when up. :thumbsup:
